this_unit_runs.failing_step: Reject changed paths outside the PO-03 allowlist
this_unit_runs.observed_error: PO03_PATH_SCOPE_ERROR: git diff 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000...8edc4d1f984f29de3437567cc96a66252233a7fa returned non-zero exit status 128

this_unit_runs.note: This run checked the unmodified base commit of the shared PO-03 branch, so no unit content was involved at all.

independent_recurrence.note: Different unit, different producer, same branch-creation push, same zero base SHA.

independent_recurrence.observed_error: PO03_PATH_SCOPE_ERROR: git diff 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000...a9f6a41b415c59679b6881197522f15391c1f8e6 returned non-zero exit status 128

independent_recurrence.note: This branch shows no failure because its first observed run was not a branch-creation push, which is consistent with the diagnosis rather than a counterexample.

diagnosis.statement: On a push that creates a branch, GitHub sets github.event.before to the zero SHA. The shared path-scope job passes that value to check_path_scope.py --base, git diff rejects it, and the job exits 2. Every newly created po03/** route branch therefore reports a red first run, and the changed-path comparison for that first commit is never evaluated by this job.
diagnosis.coverage_effect: The second job's unconditional working-tree scan still runs and passed on every observed run, so the allowlist was never actually violated. The gap is in the range comparison, not in the tree scan.
diagnosis.operational_risk: A reproducible red first run on every isolated route branch trains operators to discount this workflow's failures, which is the condition under which a genuine out-of-allowlist first commit would pass unnoticed.

remediation_proposal.proposal: When github.event.before is absent or all zeros, fall back to the merge base against the shared PO-03 branch, or to the commit's first parent, instead of failing the step.
remediation_proposal.reason: .github/workflows/po03-*.yml is inside the commission allowlist but is owned by the integration controller under workstreams/po03/control/path-ownership.json, so this unit reports the defect instead of editing the shared gate.
